lines.text: Many learners say: Please don't smoking here.

native.tip: Kita bilang “jangan merokok di sini”. Di bahasa Inggris, setelah don't pakai kata kerja dasar: smoke, bukan smoking.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Please don't smoking here.” 😅 Setelah don't, pakai kata kerja dasar: “Please don't smoke here.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “smoke”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “Please don't smoke here.” lalu tulis satu aturan dengan please don't. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “jangan merokok di sini”. In English, after don't use the base verb: smoke, not smoking.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Please don't smoking here.” 😅 After don't, use the base verb: “Please don't smoke here.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
